Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Gabriel Rubin on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

President Donald Trump on September 9 proposed to pay every U.S. adult a $5,000 "Trump dividend" if ​Republicans keep control of Congress in the November midterm elections. The pledge came during the first day of a party convention being held in Dallas.

The Treasury Department said on the same day that it would ‌repurchase as much as $6 billion in 10- to 20-year U.S. ​bonds during a buyback ​operation on September 10, triple ⁠the amount of its ​last such operation.
